name: Navigate the 17-page kindness hub, explore belonging, and complete a challenge
description: Verifies the main navigation connects the distinct pages and the challenge action updates saved progress.
steps: Open Discover challenges from the sidebar
Open a challenge detail and complete it
Open My dashboard and Kindness calendar
Open Belonging & respect from the Explore menu and review the equal-dignity message
Choose Explore inclusion challenges and verify the Inclusion & equality filter is selected
expected: All 17 pages are reachable; the Belonging & respect page communicates equal dignity for every faith and none; inclusion challenges are filterable; completing a challenge updates progress.

name: Share, like, filter, and retain a community story
description: Checks the full community contribution flow and durable browser-local state.
steps: Open Share a good deed and submit a story with at least eight characters
Open Community wall and like the new story
Filter the wall and search for a word from the story
Refresh the page
Submit a story and select Inclusion & equality as its category
Filter the Community wall by Inclusion & equality
expected: The story appears on the wall with its chosen category, its heart count changes when liked, search and filtering work (including Inclusion & equality), and the story and like remain after refresh.

name: Save a journal reflection and profile preferences
description: Verifies personal pages support editable content and preferences.
steps: Open Kindness journal and save a titled reflection
Open Settings, change the display name and a preference, then save
Open My profile
expected: The reflection appears in the journal, the updated name appears in the profile, and the preference remains active during the session.

name: Use navigation and community pages on a mobile viewport
description: Checks the main mobile navigation and representative interactive page layouts.
steps: Tap the standard three-line hamburger icon in the top-left to open the navigation drawer
Tap the menu toggle again to close it, then reopen it and use the drawer close button
Tap the backdrop to dismiss the menu, then reopen it
Choose Discover challenges and verify the drawer closes after navigation
Open the menu again and press Escape to dismiss it
Open Kindness calendar and navigate to the previous month
Open Kindness events and mark an event as interested
Open Community wall and search for a story
expected: The standard three-line hamburger icon opens the left drawer and changes to a close icon while open; the toggle, drawer close button, backdrop, or Escape key dismisses it, and selecting a menu option navigates and closes it automatically. Pages remain usable without horizontal overflow, calendar navigation works, event interest toggles, and story search filters results.

name: Validate forms and reset local demo data
description: Ensures invalid entries are blocked and the user can intentionally reset local demo state.
steps: Submit Share a good deed with fewer than eight characters
Open Kindness journal and submit without a title
Open Settings and confirm Reset local demo data
expected: Invalid forms show validation feedback without creating records; confirming reset clears local progress and restores the starter demo data.
